shots.manualNote: `-uitest-freeze-now` pins the clock, but the feed and the article-links sidecar still come from production, so which events on 2026-07-30 carry a linked article is NOT reproducible the way the clock pin is. On iPad, the detail column is populated by `AppModel.uiTestLinkedEvent(at: 1, dayKey: "2026-07-30")` — day-scoped, per #255 — and if that day ever holds fewer than 2 linked events, the call returns nil (by design, no season-wide fallback) and the detail column silently shows its 'Select an event' placeholder (AppModel.swift ~1743-1752) instead of an event. A recapture that shows a blank/placeholder detail pane on iPad means the linked-event count for 2026-07-30 dropped, not that the mechanism broke.

shots.manualNote: Not automatable via plain simctl launch args (widgets live on SpringBoard, not in the app). On each capture simulator: install a SIGNED build (CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO strips the App Group entitlement and the widgets render empty), launch the app once so the App Group cache populates, star 2-3 events, then long-press the Home Screen -> Edit -> Add Widget -> 'CHQ Calendar' and place the small Next Up widget and the small Starred widget side by side. Set the status bar first (xcrun simctl status_bar <udid> override --time 9:41 --batteryState charged --batteryLevel 100 --cellularMode active --cellularBars 4 --wifiMode active --wifiBars 3), then capture with 'xcrun simctl io <udid> screenshot' (raw device resolution is already the required 1320x2868 iPhone / 2064x2752 iPad) into ios/Scripts/out/raw/<device-key>/10-widget.png and re-run compose-screenshots.py.
